_comment: Short lines the bot says WHILE a tool runs, so the caller never hears silence. One is picked at random. Edit freely; keep them short and natural. 'default' is used for any tool without its own list. A '<tool>.<channel>' key (e.g. 'escalate.voice') is tried before the bare '<tool>' key — use it when a line is only true on one channel, like promising a transfer that only voice can perform.
check_availability: Let me check what we've got open.
One second, I'll look at the diary.
book_job: Great, booking that in for you now.
Perfect — putting that in the diary.
escalate: Hold on, I'm getting someone on this right now.
One moment — alerting our on-call team.
escalate.voice: Hold on, I'm getting someone for you right now.
Stay with me — putting you through now.
